newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa stocks falter to close in nervous trade.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa stocks falter to close in nervous trade.

text.p: South African shares ended weak in active trade, with the industrial and all-share indices shedding over 100 points on negative sentiment. Gold shares eased in sympathy.
"It was a very weak market. The Dow is down, the rand is weak and the futures close-out is approaching on Tuesday. Sentiment is just not right," one dealer said.
The market was knocked by the Dow Jones' 98.81 points slide on Thursday night to 6,303.7 points.
Dealers said the local market was jittery in line with world markets. Blue chip stocks were the hardest hit, they said.
The industrial index fell 132.2 points to 7,682.5 points, the all share index lost 124.5 points to 6,482.5 points and the gold index dropped 21.6 points to 1,511.6 points.
